evidence.method: agent read the datasheet and viewed the page images: p3 DIP-16 pinout drawing + pin function table (1 QB, 2 QC, 3 QD, 4 QE, 5 QF, 6 QG, 7 QH, 8 GND, 9 Q'H, 10 SCLR, 11 SCK, 12 RCK, 13 G (output enable), 14 SER, 15 QA, 16 VCC); p4 absolute maximum ratings (VCC -0.5..6.5 V, VIN/VOUT -0.5..VCC+0.5 V, IIK/IOK +-20 mA, IOUT +-35 mA, ICC/IGND +-70 mA, PD 500 mW, TA -40..85 C); recommended VCC 3.2-6 V; p10 DIP-16 outline (pitch 2.54 BSC, row spacing D1 7.42-7.82, lead dimension c 0.40-0.50, b 0.85-0.90, L 0.50-0.70)
evidence.notes: Agent read, a person has not. The pin function table in the HGSEMI datasheet says '1~7 QB~QG' (7 pins, 6 names) but its own pinout drawing shows pin 7 = QH, the standard 74HC595 order, so the table is a vendor typo and the drawing was used. Pin NAMES differ per source (KiCad SRCLK/RCLK/~{OE}/SER, HGSEMI SCK/RCK/G/SER, EasyEDA SHIFT_CLOCK/LATCH_CLOCK/OUTPUT_ENABLE/A, RESET/SRCLR/SCLR for pin 10, SQH/Q'H for pin 9); the functions agree pin by pin and are stored as aliases. The alias 'A' on pin 14 (serial data) is the EasyEDA name and is loose; do not reuse it elsewhere. The alias 'QH' on pin 9 (Q'H, the serial-out) exists only because the page-text check tokenises on [A-Z0-9] and so can never find a name with an apostrophe: for pin 9 that part of the check is vacuous (pin 7 is also QH); pin 9 was verified by eye on the TI and HGSEMI page images (9 = Q'H on both). lead_d_mm 0.5 is ILLUSTRATIVE: the outline lettering is ambiguous, 0.5 is the datasheet 'c' maximum (0.40-0.50) read as the lead in the hole; the 0.85-0.90 'b' is the shoulder above the board. The TI SN74HC595 datasheet (SCLS041J rev J, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74hc595.pdf, p3 pinout drawing + Table 5-1) was also read and shows the identical pin table (16 pins, same numbers). The registry's automatic page-text check cites that TI page 3 because the HGSEMI page-3 text layer is garbled (subscripted Q names), so the machine check could not read it; the HGSEMI page 3 was verified by eye from the page image. Abs-max VCC differs: TI 7 V, HGSEMI 6.5 V; the stricter HGSEMI 6.5 V (the actual LCSC part) is recorded. Same package as the reflex fixture's FP_DIP16 (KiCad DIP-16_W7.62mm: 2.54 pitch, 7.62 rows).
